name: Pyrophenidone
summary: An NDRI pyrovalerone derivative reported to have similar subjective effects to pyrovalerone. There is very limited information on the drug, further research is strongly recommended.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: It is reported to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline, like pyrovalerone.
pharmacology.zh: 據報導，它和吡咯戊酮一樣會阻斷多巴胺和正腎上腺素的再回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 据报导，它和吡咯戊酮一样会阻断多巴胺和正肾上腺素的再回收。

uses.en: It has appeared as a rarely seen recreational stimulant and research chemical. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾以罕見的娛樂用興奮劑和研究化學品的形式出現，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以罕见的娱乐用兴奋剂和研究化学品的形式出现，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Synthetic cathinones of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and paranoia, and often lead to compulsive redosing. Serious risks include seizures and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類合成卡西酮可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠和偏執，也常導致強迫性追加。嚴重風險包括癲癇發作和血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类合成卡西酮可能引起心跳过快、高血压、体温过高、焦虑、失眠和偏执，也常导致强迫性追加。严重风险包括癫痫发作和血清素症候群。

fact.en: Like pyrovalerone, it belongs to the pyrrolidinophenone family, which was first explored in the 1960s and whose best-known modern member is α-PVP.
fact.zh: 它和吡咯戊酮一樣屬於吡咯烷苯酮類，這個家族在 1960 年代首次被研究，最知名的現代成員是 α-PVP。
fact.zhHans: 它和吡咯戊酮一样属于吡咯烷苯酮类，这个家族在 1960 年代首次被研究，最知名的现代成员是 α-PVP。
